_comment: Snapshot expectations, not biological constants. Obtained from the UniProt snapshot uniprot_reviewed_glycoproteins_2026-04-27.tsv.gz joined to pairs_master.csv filtered to analysis_ready == True, keyed on (pos_accession, best_loss_positive_position), requiring an exact N-linked CARBOHYD feature with ECO:0000269 or ECO:0007744, deduplicated after the pair join. A mismatch means upstream data changed - investigate the inputs before editing this file.
